the question, PREREG.md section 1: how far FleXray's synthetic DRRs are from real X-rays, plain film and intra-operative fluoroscopy, whether that distance is larger than the distance between two real corpora, and whether this project's rendering of FleXray's recipe reproduces FleXray's own; the hypotheses and their bars, its section 4: the logistic C2ST AUC of flexray_drr, flexray_drr_ct, fluxray against pooled fluoroscopy and pooled film in the flexray space, inversion-invariant, each with its interval and its gap ratio, worded indistinguishable where the AUC's lower bound is at most 0.6, closer than two real corpora where it is below the median AUC of the family's real pairs and separable otherwise; and the replication verdict, replicated where flexray_replica against flexray_reference has a lower bound of at most 0.6 and an MMD q of at least 0.05

retrospective: every real image comes from a corpus the project already held, and every synthetic one is rendered in the job from held CTs or read from a held set (PREREG.md section 2), so no image was acquired for the study; the design was frozen before any number of the study was read (its section 7)

a measurement under pre-registered hypotheses: the primary endpoints and the replication verdict of PREREG.md section 4, every other number read as description (its section 6); the study trains no network and builds no model for use

the design fixes caps, not a target: each group at most its cap of images (1000, 100) and at most 1 to 100 a person by group, 300 images from each testable real group in a pooled family, at most 600 a group in the maps, and a group tested only with at least 20 decoded images and five persons (PREREG.md sections 2 and 3; data/domain_gap/groups.json, version 1, sha256 92a1-640b-70f1-b6c6 as the record names it); the render groups were planned on 250 CTs and stand on the CTs the segmentation job covered (DEVIATIONS.md, item 1), summary.txt: render totalsegmentator_v201: 27 CTs chosen of 27 with every mask of 1228 CTs (moose 27, spineps 27); 26 kept by every group; no file of the study records a power calculation for any size, and the bar of 0.6 is by the design's own account neither a published value nor a power calculation's (PREREG.md section 4)
